document_metadata.title: 84、EXT. LAKE IN FOREST - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Alexei holds Nadia underwater, causing concern; she resurfaces angry, swims away, and John observes as Yuri reprimands Alexei, who then leaves for shore.

entities.description: Four individuals run towards a lake while wearing only their underwear and leap into the water, initiating a period of playful activity.

entities.description: John remains in the water, observing the two as they recover and express joy after their underwater dive.

entities.summary: A man reflects on communication and self-awareness while observing movers, preparing a bed, and waiting at an airport. He meets Nadia, continues a conversation in a car, and drives nervously with her, revealing personal anxieties during the journey.

entities.name: Alexei
entities.description: One of the group members playing in the lake who interacts physically with Nadia by throwing her into the air and later dives and resurfaces with her.
entities.summary: A group of individuals, including Yuri and a dark-haired Russian man, gather in a clearing where rituals, guitar playing, and intimate moments occur; one man kills an ant, showing it to Yuri as 'Nasyekski,' while others sleep or interact quietly, linked to Novgorod.

entities.name: Nadia
entities.description: One of the group members playing in the lake who is thrown into the air by Alexei and later dives and resurfaces with him.

entities.name: Alexei holds Nadia under water while John treads nearby

entities.name: John swims toward Alexei to intervene
entities.description: Seeing Nadia remain underwater too long, John begins swimming toward Alexei in apparent concern, intending to intervene in the situation.

entities.name: Alexei releases Nadia and she surfaces coughing
entities.description: Just as John approaches, Alexei lets go of Nadia, allowing her to come up for air; she surfaces coughing and spluttering, visibly distressed.

entities.name: Nadia shouts at Alexei in Russian and pushes him away
entities.description: After surfacing, Nadia angrily shouts at Alexei in Russian, clearly upset, and physically resists him by pushing him away twice, nearly slapping him.

entities.name: Nadia swims away from Alexei visibly uncomfortable
entities.description: Feeling distressed and uncomfortable, Nadia breaks away from Alexei and swims off by herself, distancing from the interaction.

entities.name: Yuri admonishes Alexei in Russian
entities.description: Yuri, observing the situation, reprimands his friend Alexei in Russian, expressing disapproval of his behavior toward Nadia.

entities.name: Alexei stares at John and swims back to shore
entities.description: After being confronted by Yuri and noticing John, Alexei gives John a hard stare before turning and swimming forcefully back toward the lakeshore.

entities.name: Yuri explains Alexei's behavior to John
entities.description: Yuri tells John in English that Alexei was only having fun but acknowledges that he may be too strong, offering a justification for his friend's actions.

entities.name: John watches Nadia walk out of the lake to her clothes
entities.description: After the tense underwater incident, John observes Nadia as she exits the water and walks toward her clothes on the shore, ending her participation in the lake activity.

entities.name: Yuri
entities.description: A man who is present during the incident at the lake and admonishes Alexei in Russian, later explaining Alexei's behavior to John.
entities.summary: A Russian man from Novgorod arrives uninvited at Nadia's birthday, interacts with John and Nadia using humor and coded language, while reflections on binoculars, translation, emotional silence, and observed rest unfold around him.
